title: Red team engagement plan
description: Web assessment automation: ProjectDiscovery stack (subfinder, httpx, naabu), nuclei, dalfox, sqlmap, xcrawl3r, waybackurls/gau, nikto, and JS secret patterns (api_leak). Manual phases list follow-up work outside this pipeline.
methodology_frameworks: NIST SP 800-115 — Technical Guide for Security Testing

manual_phases.name: OSINT and passive mapping
tasks: OsintLab / OSINT Framework / web-check / urlscan.io / osint.tools — map metadata and relations
DNSDumpster + Censys on CDN edge IP; compare DNS completeness vs production baselines
Synapsint, SubdomainRadar, URLVoid for reputation and exposure
SpiderFoot, crt.sh — certificate transparency and passive intel

manual_phases.name: Active recon and DNS
tasks: MassDNS, dnsx — validate hosts; zone transfer checks where in scope
subfinder + httpx + naabu — confirm live hosts and ports
Origin leak / real-IP discovery — correlate with attack platform and CDN roles

manual_phases.name: Web and CDN testing (manual)
tasks: Burp Suite Pro + domain_hunter_pro; OWASP ZAP for proxy, spider, fuzzing
CDN/cache: poisoning, deception, bypass, HTTP smuggling (CL.TE / TE.CL), H2 issues — lab only
Jaeles, Nmap + NSE, testssl.sh — supplementary to automated nuclei/naabu/nikto
HExHTTP, 403jump, gobuster — tune wordlists for the target

manual_phases.name: Traffic and artifacts
tasks: tcpdump / mirror site → bulk_extractor on PCAP or downloaded tree
Mantra on JS URL lists: waybackurls|gau → .js → patterns (partially covered by api_leak module)

manual_phases.name: Reporting and blue-team handoff
tasks: CVSS v3.1 + business impact, PoC, remediation
Mend Red-Teaming-Practical-Guide PDF for narrative structure
